# Yaratu / Ярату

RU+EN+TT product range with disclosed ingredients. Nutrition is calculated, not laboratory-tested. All five current products are covered by Halal certificate No. 614A/2024 issued by the Spiritual Administration of Muslims of the Republic of Tatarstan.

- [Ветчина филейная](https://yaratu.com/products/vetchina/) / [Chicken fillet ham](https://yaratu.com/en/products/vetchina/) / [Филелы ветчина](https://yaratu.com/tt/products/vetchina/) · QR https://yaratu.com/q/vetchina
- [Колбаса варёно-копчёная «Мраморная»](https://yaratu.com/products/mramornaya/) / [Mramornaya cooked smoked sausage](https://yaratu.com/en/products/mramornaya/) / [Пешерелгән-ысланган «Мраморная» колбаса](https://yaratu.com/tt/products/mramornaya/) · QR https://yaratu.com/q/mramornaya
- [Сосиски с брокколи](https://yaratu.com/products/brokkoli/) / [Sausages with broccoli](https://yaratu.com/en/products/brokkoli/) / [Брокколилы сосискалар](https://yaratu.com/tt/products/brokkoli/) · QR https://yaratu.com/q/brokkoli
- [Сосиски «Молочные»](https://yaratu.com/products/molochnye/) / [Molochnye milk sausages](https://yaratu.com/en/products/molochnye/) / [«Молочные» сосискалар](https://yaratu.com/tt/products/molochnye/) · QR https://yaratu.com/q/molochnye
- [Колбаса варёная «Сливочная»](https://yaratu.com/products/slivochnaya/) / [Slivochnaya cooked sausage](https://yaratu.com/en/products/slivochnaya/) / [Пешерелгән «Сливочная» колбаса](https://yaratu.com/tt/products/slivochnaya/) · QR https://yaratu.com/q/slivochnaya
